set.definition: select "ontology"."node_version"."id", "ontology"."node_version"."version", "ontology"."node_version"."action", "ontology"."node"."type", "ontology"."work_version"."title", "ontology"."node_version"."timestamp", "version_zero"."timestamp" as "created_at" from "ontology"."work_version" inner join "ontology"."node_version" on (("ontology"."work_version"."id" = "ontology"."node_version"."id") and ("ontology"."work_version"."version" = "ontology"."node_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."node" on "ontology"."work_version"."id" = "ontology"."node"."id" inner join "ontology"."node_version" "version_zero" on (("ontology"."work_version"."id" = "version_zero"."id") and ("version_zero"."version" = 0)) where ((not exists (select 1 from "ontology"."node_version" "newer" where (("newer"."id" = "ontology"."work_version"."id") and ("newer"."version" > "ontology"."work_version"."version")))) and (case "ontology"."node"."type" when 'book' then exists (select 1 from "ontology"."book_version" where (("ontology"."work_version"."id" = "ontology"."book_version"."id") and ("ontology"."work_version"."version" = "ontology"."book_version"."version")) offset 0) when 'essay' then exists (select 1 from "ontology"."essay_version" where (("ontology"."work_version"."id" = "ontology"."essay_version"."id") and ("ontology"."work_version"."version" = "ontology"."essay_version"."version")) offset 0) else false end))
